theme: How many of us are there?

rounds.q: What % of the world's people live in India or China?
rounds.why: India now has about 42 million more people than China, after overtaking it.
rounds.fun: India passed China by about 42 million people. Together they hold 35% of us!

rounds.q: What % of the world's people are children under 15?
rounds.why: That share has slid from nearly 27% in 2015.
rounds.fun: 1 in 4 people is a kid under 15. That's recess for a quarter of the planet!

rounds.q: By 2050, what % of the world's people will be over 65?
rounds.why: In 2019 it was one person in 11. By the late 2070s, over-65s will outnumber children.
rounds.fun: By the late 2070s, folks over 65 will outnumber kids. Shuffleboard, anyone?

rounds.q: What % of people live in a country whose population has already peaked?
rounds.why: That's 63 countries, including China, Germany and Japan.
rounds.fun: 63 countries have already hit their population peak. The party stopped growing!

rounds.q: How many billion people will Earth have at its peak?
rounds.why: The UN expects about 10.3 billion in the mid-2080s, then a slow dip.
rounds.fun: Earth's guest list tops out at about 10.3 billion in the mid-2080s. Pass the snacks!
